name: Dancing for Marzipan
summary: Innkeeper Pala asks Dancing for Marzipan visitors to dance during Hallow's End in Thunder Bluff. The treat is meant for a sick orphan, and the custom brings holiday cheer to Mulgore's high mesas.

sections.title: A Dance on the Bluff
sections.body: During Hallow's End, Innkeeper Pala keeps the trick-or-treat custom in Thunder Bluff. Even when you come for an ailing child, she asks for a festive dance before giving up her Thunder Bluff Marzipan.

sections.title: Tricks for Treats
sections.body: For Pala, the custom is simple: step forward and dance to earn a sweet. When you have entertained her, she gives you the marzipan and warm wishes for the sick youth waiting for it.

faq.q: What is the purpose of Dancing for Marzipan?
faq.answer: You dance for Innkeeper Pala in Thunder Bluff to receive a piece of Thunder Bluff Marzipan. It joins the holiday treats gathered for a sick orphan during Hallow's End.
Innkeeper Pala, the tauren innkeeper who serves visitors and locals in Thunder Bluff, offers it during Hallow's End.

faq.q: Why does Pala insist on a dance if the candy is for a sick child?
aliases: why do i have to dance
why does pala want a dance
faq.answer: Pala honors the trick-or-treat custom: you perform a trick to earn a sweet, keeping Hallow's End joyful and lively.

faq.q: What reward do you receive for dancing?
faq.answer: You receive a piece of Thunder Bluff Marzipan, a local festive confection needed for the larger Hallow's End treat collection for the sick child.

faq.q: Can Alliance players complete this quest?
faq.answer: No. Innkeeper Pala lives in Thunder Bluff, so only members of the Horde can visit her for this stop on the holiday treat run.
It is available during Hallow's End, the annual autumn holiday when innkeepers across Azeroth offer special sweets and festive games.

angles.text: As a tauren, you can find Innkeeper Pala bringing holiday cheer to Mulgore with a dance for a sweet cause.
As a member of the Horde, you can share a lighter moment amid the faction's daily struggles and bring holiday joy to an orphan as you travel between capital cities.
